name: Sheep pen
about: A fenced field for sheep, with a gate and a little shelter in the corner.

layers.name: Shelter floor
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Swap the grass in the back left corner for oak planks. Leave the rest as grass: sheep eat it, and it grows back.

layers.name: Fence
layers.tip: Put a fence all the way around, with a gate in the middle of the front. One more fence post holds up the shelter roof.

layers.name: Shelter roof and lights
layers.tip: Oak slabs over the corner make the shelter. Torches on the other corners help stop monsters appearing inside. Hold wheat and sheep will follow you in.
